author: Hacktivism
body:
Key Features:
- A ton of TNT
- It's a TNT map that won't get rushed in two minutes
- Monument structure makes it easy to defend, harder to rush
- Some hidden items in the map, see for yourself c:

Download
Gallery
YAML

Loadout:


Changelog:
Version 1.1:
- Added trees
- Added two oases on each side
- Restructured monument
- Restructured spawn
- Increased map depth
- Added bedrock beneath map
- Decreased void gap distance
- Added limited iron supplies
- Changed monuments to emerald blocks
- Decreased TNT supply
- Overall improvement of aesthetics
Version 1.2:
- Changed monuments back to obsidian blocks
- Added efficiency II enchantment to pickaxe
- Changed iron pickaxe to diamond in loadout
- Changed iron helmet and boots to leather in loadout
- Added infinity I enchantment to bow
- Changed stained clay to cyan on one side
- Reward one dispenser per kill
